proposition_chain.statement: The estimation samples are built in three layers: (a) the base call panel (every matched Capital IQ call of a US public, non-financial, non-utility firm 2002-2018, excluding CEOs with fewer than five calls, for whom no style and hence no residual is estimable); (b) the SDC deal universe (US public acquirer 2002-2018, status in {completed, pending, withdrawn}, known payment composition; >=50%-cash deals form the cash arm, >=50%-stock the stock placebo arm, each firm's first qualifying deal setting its event clock); and (c) design-specific trims (the run-up test drops treated post-announcement quarters; the event studies cap the post-window at four quarters and truncate at the firm's next announcement; the scrutiny validity/channel tests require at least three analyst Q&A turns per call). The >=5-call filter is stated here as a MECHANIC; its selection-THREAT framing is homed in 2.4 P5.5.
proposition_chain.role_in_paragraph: premise -- the sole three-layer-sample proposition; the single explanation for varying N
proposition_chain.reason: Without the three-layer logic the varying counts read as inconsistency; placed after sources/link/build/routing because the layers are filters on the linked, built panel, and it must precede Table 1.
